text:
Jun: Heads up — noticed a pattern in last night's multiregion rollout: a bunch of requests to EU are spiking 800ms+ on first token, then drop to normal. looks like cold-start + KMS handshake + cache miss chain.
Maria: saw that too. New tenants especially. telemetry shows cipher unwrap taking ~200ms and model shard hydration ~400ms.
Sam: do we have an isolation boundary where KMS calls must land in tenant-resident region? could be adding cross-region latency.
Jun: yes, KMS calls are region-resident for privacy guarantees. we purposefully do key unwrap in-region. tradeoff: strong residency but first-request latency hit.
Alice: quick question — how frequent are these first-request hits? is it only after a host replacement or also after scale-down?
Maria: mostly after scale-down (preemptible node pools) and after deploys that rotate GPUs. also after long idle windows.
Sam: two immediate options: 1) warm pools (keep one instance hot per region per model tier) or 2) async key-provisioning: prefetch KMS tokens to another region under strict audit and only decrypt in-region. both have pros/cons.
Jun: exactly. warm pools = $$$ constant cost. async prefetch = complexity + audit surface. also legal may block prefetch for some EU/DE tenants.
Alice: what about an operator-only knob: "aggressive-warmup=true" for tenants who opt in to lower latency at cost of cross-region key fetch? keeps default safe.
Maria: that could work. add a consent flag in tenant metadata and a runtime check in route table. also need UI in Console plus an audit log entry.
Sam: implementation sketch: when a tenant is created, include residency policy: {"residency":"EU_ONLY","warmup_consented":false}. If warmup_consented true, we asynchronously fetch a KMS-wrapped prefetch token to the primary region's warm pool during offpeak.
Jun: pseudocode example I pasted in the runbook:
```
POST /internal/tenants/:id/warmup
{ "model":"gpt-medium","region":"eu-west-1" }
// controller: reserve one warm slot, schedule KMS prewrap job
```
Maria: Perf telemetry needs to add a "warmup_source" tag so we can break down cold starts from KMS vs model load. right now it's lumped together.
Alice: agree. add tracing ops: span for kms.unwrap + span for shard.load + span for kvcache.hydration. then we can set SLIs.
Sam: as for privacy: legal OK'd warm pools *only if* the unwrapped keys never leave the region and prefetch only stores wrapped tokens. we need PR to doc that.
Jun: rollout plan proposal:
- phase 0: add telemetry spans + tenant metadata flag (low risk)
- phase 1: add operator warm-pools behind feature flag + manual opt-in per tenant
- phase 2: eval async prefetch prototype for opt-in tenants and measure cost delta
- phase 3: decide default policy based on cost/usage after 6 weeks
Maria: sounds pragmatic. add a canary: enable warm-pool for a single internal tenant for 24h and watch cost + latency.
deploy-bot: canary deploy finished: feature/warm-pool-telemetry -> canary (eu-west-1) :white_check_mark:
Alice: I'll own the Console flag + audit logs. Maria can own telemetry, Sam can prototype prefetch job. Jun will shepherd the rollout.
Sam: one more edge: for private (on-prem) customers we can't prefetch at all. ensure the controller respects deployment type.
Jun: noted. also add runbook step: if cold-start latency > 600ms for >5% qps in 1h, trigger warm-pool scale-up suggestion.
Maria: I'll add a dashboard and an alert for that. link to draft dashboard: https://internal.redwood/dash/warmup-latency
Alice: thanks everyone. I'll create the tenant metadata PR and a short explainer for Legal.
Jun: thanks — will follow up with timeline tomorrow. :thumbsup:
